body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Enspert(www.enspert.com) introduced mobile receiver 'ATSC-M/H' which supports American TV broadcasting service for Tablet PC at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
(Picture: Watching mobile TV is possible when connecting ATSC-M/H with Tablet PC 'E201' of Enspert)
(Picture: Watching mobile TV is possible when connecting ATSC-M/H with Tablet PC 'E201' of Enspert)
